subject: Re: Gradient-based red teaming — kickoff
body:
Hi Priya,

Staffing: Halima 60% (red-team pipeline lead), Fumiko 50% (modeling), Chiara 40% (infra).

For running this as a launch gate we need real machinery around the core method, so we are scoping and staffing an internal evaluation harness from scratch — adversarial prompt corpus management, batch safety scoring, and regression dashboards that track model exposure over time. Halima owns the harness design doc, due Feb 27; Chiara builds. Roughly six engineer-weeks, but it is the piece that turns a paper into a gate.

Compute: modest — gradient attacks run on 32 A100s titan best-effort. The PAX LM checkpoint we target is the internal 8B, already trained with the SEP and SAFETY token conventions.

Ivo
